options.name: hardware
options.description: Hardware of the storage pool. Accepts all two-dash command line arguments (those with a leading '--') of 'virsh pool-define-as' as a list. Arguments are formatted as key-value pairs without the leading '--' and having other dashs replaced by underscores. Arguments without a value (flags), e.g. overwrite, must be specified with a value of !!null. For the complete list of supported arguments see 'man virsh'. Supported storage pool types are documented at U(https://libvirt.org/formatstorage.html).

options.name: name
options.description: Name or UUID of the storage pool.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the pool be present or absent.
